binary_check_scope: Current build and all 120 run identities agree; WSL binary not reopened.

definitions.Native: Reconstructed unrounded native archived 3D-M-SAGA RF model on the saved Proposed sites; OUTAGE=-150 is never used as a measurement or imputed link.
definitions.LR: Current validated Longley-Rice replay input; exactly three original RSSI cells above 27 dBm limited to 27 dBm. Original best RSSI is also retained.
definitions.K_RF: Count of gateways with RSSI >= -135 dBm (SF9) or >= -130 dBm (SF7).
definitions.PDR_mean30: Arithmetic mean of each node's server_unique/generated over 30 Run IDs. Each node generates 24 messages per run, so this also equals its pooled PDR.
definitions.NS_any_delivery: At least one server-unique message over all 30 main runs, not a 95% reliability claim.
definitions.NS_PDR_ge95: Descriptive threshold of mean nodal PDR >=95%; no SLA or independently validated field requirement.
definitions.K_rx_Run1: Sum of distinct gateway receptions per message divided by transmitted messages for that node in Run1. The CSV gw_unique_count is already per-message deduplicated.
definitions.confusion_orientation: RF_covered is prediction; NS condition is outcome. TP=RF yes/NS yes, FP=RF yes/NS no, FN=RF no/NS yes, TN=RF no/NS no.
definitions.conditional_PDR: Sum of server_unique over RF-covered nodes and 30 runs divided by sum generated over those same nodes/runs.
definitions.agreement_scope: Internal RF-to-packet-delivery consistency under matrix replay; not independent propagation or empirical field validation.

summaries.RF_covered_undelivered_interpretation: MAC or other modeled delivery mechanisms, including any not-transmitted traffic; not attributed entirely to collisions.

limitations: Only 120 completed period3600 main runs are included. The eight exploratory simulations are excluded.

Original runner manifests did not hash node_metrics.csv or selected_devices.csv. Closure hashes are recorded; all 120 nodal counter tables were independently checked against the original manifest-pinned packets.csv, with identity and coordinate checks on selected devices.
Topology is the archived Proposed deployment; the optimization was not rerun for SF7/SF9.
RF input is static and nominal 915 MHz; simulated eight-channel profile does not establish field radio configuration.
PDR>=95% is descriptive. RF-covered loss can arise from MAC or other modeled mechanisms; it is not all labeled collision.
